name: Text select
description: Selecting text: a paragraph on a card, an I-beam drags across a phrase as the highlight grows word by word, lets go, and a small toolbar pops over the selection with one action pressed.

text.label: Paragraph
text.default: The best edits feel invisible. Every cut lands on purpose, every caption arrives on the word, and the story never waits for the tools.

select.label: Phrase to select
select.default: every caption arrives on the word
